description: Theme your terminal from PowerShell, zsh or bash with live-previewed styles.
post_install: # TerminalStyles reads this marker to know Scoop owns this copy: `tstyles update`
# then points at `scoop update`, and `tstyles uninstall` leaves the module for
# `scoop uninstall` instead of deleting files Scoop tracks.
notes: To load TerminalStyles in every new PowerShell tab, run once:
Then open a new tab and run: tstyles
